overview_description.description:
Aura Vision enables brick-and-mortar retailers to positively influence shopper journeys with cutting-edge computer vision.

The company help brands and retailers improve their in-store experiences by tracking visitor demographics, movement and engagement from existing security cameras.

about_short_description.short_description: Aura Vision is digitising physical retail with plug & play AI to maximise the value of every customer.

product.name: In-store Analytics Platform
product.description: A platform that converts existing CCTV footage into anonymous, AI-driven retail analytics to measure footfall, customer demographics, and in-store behavior without additional sensors.

product.name: Footfall Counting and Conversion Analysis
product.description: A service that provides accurate counts of store visitors and analyzes conversion rates by comparing foot traffic to actual purchases using AI on CCTV footage.

product.name: Staff Planning Optimization
product.description: A tool that helps retail managers plan and allocate staff resources based on real-time and historical customer traffic data to meet demand efficiently.

product.name: Path to Purchase Analysis
product.description: An AI-driven analysis that identifies key moments and customer behaviors along the in-store journey to improve store design, marketing, and merchandising effectiveness.

product.name: Brand Performance Platform
product.description: A platform that delivers competitive insights on product engagement and customer demographics to retail brand partners, supporting marketing and sales strategies.
